# Current Architecture — Module Dependency Graph

**Generated:** 2026-10-02 (from the Go build graph — regenerated by
`generate-module-graph.sh`, replace this file after structural changes).
**Supersedes:** `2026-05-03_08-50-CURRENT-ARCHITECTURE.d2` and
`2026-05-03_08-50-IMPROVED-ARCHITECTURE.d2` (5 months stale, kept for history).

## Reading the graph

- Arrows point from importer to imported ("X depends on Y").
- `internal/domain/*` sits at the bottom (enums ← operations ← types DAG);
  nothing depends downward — the layering is clean.
- `internal/cleaner/<name>` sub-packages depend on the shared cleaner core
  (`internal/cleaner`) and domain; none of them depend on each other.
- `internal/execution` is renderer-agnostic (defines `ProgressEmitter`);
  `internal/progress` implements it with go-output/nom and tui (ADR-0002).
- `internal/report` maps results to go-output/daghtml + graph artifacts.
- `cmd/clean-wizard/commands` is the composition boundary: DI wiring, flag
  gating (TTY/json/sarif), and emitter construction.
